title: The Bubble That Held the Room
youtube_title: The Bubble That Held the Room | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet noticing is a way of being gentle with the world.
summary: At a library aisle with a slice of sun, Kira finds a soap bubble that held a bent picture of the room. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Kira shows Hiro how to look without disturbing it. Nana Ruth looks too, and they leave it where it is.
